_note: metrics are the reference commit's medians on the box of the day — a trend record, not the gate. The gate rebuilds ref_commit and measures it against the candidate in the same session.
_note_tiered: the tiered_hotset_* stubs (capacity arc A2: hot-set throughput with tiering on) are null until lx64 records them against a tiered instance — same skip-with-notice discipline.
_note_table: the table_* stubs (capacity arc T7: C4 point lookup / C5 filter+sort page / C7 write tax) are null until their baselines are recorded on lx64 — the gate skips null lines with a notice, never invents a number.
